scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@career-scout/database && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@career-scout/database && npm run build --workspace=@career-scout/server && npm run build --workspace=@career-scout/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@career-scout/database && npm run typecheck --workspace=@career-scout/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@career-scout/dashboard
